free_tier.stated: IDR 150,000 of credit for a 30-day trial, granted on registration with an email address, advertised on the registration form itself as 'Get Free IDR 150.000 Credit Bonus for 30 Days Trial'.

retention.stated: The credit expires after 30 days and the account is an OVZ NAT container with a 20 Mbps cap and no public IPv4 until it is upgraded to paid, so the free unit is time-boxed and reaches the network only over IPv6.

egress.terms: not published: no egress allowance or overage price on https://jagoancloud.com/harga-managed-vps/ or on the registration page, read 2026-11-04

interface_detail: dashboard plus SSH (Web SSH) to nodes and a kubectl client against a Remote API endpoint with an access token, as documented for Kubernetes clusters on the platform
tooling: the provider documents the kubectl client, per the cluster access page: "kubectl"
chaining: IDR 150,000 is about USD 9 at the shown rate, which is one month of a 768 MB instance; the free tier therefore buys exactly the trial period and nothing that survives it, and it composes with a paid IDR 45,182 box only by upgrading.

evidence.proved: the registration page headline reads 'Get Free IDR 150.000 Credit Bonus for 30 Days Trial', quoted from the vendor's own signup form

a user report states the free account is 'OVZ NAT VPS' with a '20Mbps' cap, no public IPv4 on the free tier, and that a '768MB' instance roughly consumes the IDR 150,000 over a month; the lowest paid tier is '45182IDR' for 1 core, 128 MB and 50 GB at 200 Mbps unlimited, reported
the paid ladder beside it: 'Nebula' 2 Core / 2 GB / 40 GB at 'Rp. 100.000 /bln' after discount from Rp. 200.000, with a 30-day money-back guarantee, quoted
the pricing page prices storage per GB-month and carries no traffic-out allowance or price

notes: The Indonesian market is the most active source of free VPS offers found, and most of them are small operators with no English page. Jagoan is the most durable of them because it is the free arm of a long-established host with a published paid ladder. The IPv6-only free tier with NAT IPv4 is the real constraint: the box is reachable, but not as a server with a stable inbound address until money changes hands.
